notes: Rule 11: al-Faqih's statement of his routes («طرق») to a source, with no saying. The three routes are read as the text writes them; the joins «جميعا» and «و» are not settled.
The source named at the start (أبي همام إسماعيل بن همام) is the end of the third route; the first two routes do not repeat it.
